task_instance: Follow the jest-test skill to write a complete Jest (TypeScript) test suite for a small sample service (a UserService with an injected UserRepository dependency plus an isValidEmail helper), covering happy path, error paths, edge cases, dependency mocking, async handling and a data-driven test, then review it against the skill's Step 4 checklist.
task_instance_note: representative, minimal instance of the skill's core stated deliverable ('write tests for this')
evidence: Read the skill doc and its referenced playbook (SKILL.md and references/jest-guide.xml under the skill repo). Created sample input source src/user-service.ts (UserService with injected UserRepository, UserNotFoundError, isValidEmail). Wrote the deliverable src/user-service.test.ts in the work directory following the skill's patterns: AAA structure, one describe per method/helper, typed jest.Mocked repository mock constructed fresh in beforeEach, afterEach with jest.clearAllMocks()+jest.restoreAllMocks(), every async test carries expect.assertions(n), error paths tested with .rejects.toThrow() (both message and error-class forms), repository error propagation, 'not called' assertions for early-return branches, and a test.each data-driven suite for isValidEmail. Verified per the skill's Step 4 review: hand-traced every test against the source and each assertion holds (7 UserService cases + 6 isValidEmail rows); confirmed all public branches are exercised (empty id, null result, found, repo rejection, invalid email no-save, valid save, save rejection); confirmed no forbidden patterns (no .only/.skip/.todo, no real timers, no floating promises, no console.log, mocks cleaned up). Files produced: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/b273891e-4b73-5af7-9840-fc512af93809/scratchpad/real2_work/r003/src/user-service.ts and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/b273891e-4b73-5af7-9840-fc512af93809/scratchpad/real2_work/r003/src/user-service.test.ts. Limitation: the runtime cannot execute code, so the suite was not run under the jest binary and coverage was not measured numerically; verification was the static anti-pattern/async/mock-hygiene/coverage checklist that the skill itself prescribes as Step 4. The core deliverable (a complete, best-practices Jest test file for the given source) exists as a text artifact and was reviewed to conform to the playbook.
